name: fzero
comment: Sig: r = fzero(fn, x0|[a,b]); [x, fval, exitflag] = fzero(...). fval = fn(x) at the root; exitflag = 1 on success (numkit throws on failure, so the success path always returns 1). The 4th 'output' struct is deferred (errors loudly). Queue-clearing 2026-05-29: fval/exitflag outputs added.
